question: At which venue was the opening ceremony of the Khelo India Youth Games, 2025, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patliputra Sports Complex**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The opening ceremony of the **7th edition** of the **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2025** was held at the **Patliputra Sports Complex** in **Patna**, **Bihar**.
 
• The mega sporting event was scheduled to take place from **January 19** to **January 30, 2025**, marking the **first time** that the state of **Bihar** hosted this national-level competition.
